verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Bots running on a persistent cloud computer that keeps working while your laptop is closed. Bots can save walked-through paths as skills and rerun them on a schedule, for example every weekday at 8:00 AM, and Cursor integrations can start routines from events such as Slack or GitHub notifications. Hands-on community reports corroborate that async, always-on work 'actually works' and that bots own their own routines. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on corroboration that the scheduled and event-triggered routines specifically fire reliably, and event triggers are documented only via Cursor account integrations.
